Per canonical credential: a = college index -> [units, [[course, credit recommendation]]] for each college that articulated it; c = college index -> [[course, "", units]] for each college that already teaches a course mapped to its M-ID identity (statewide_prescriptive.js; never the TOP or C-ID program overlap); w = colleges withheld because the identity is over-merged; x = [[exhibit id, MAP title, units]]; s = the CIP sector; p = the median articulating college's units (the peer benchmark).
